settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Change viewer settings and file associations.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Select an item, then press the keys you want. Each key can belong to one action.
shortcuts.captureHint: Select an item to change it
shortcuts.conflictDesc: {{key}} is already assigned to {{action}}. Replace it? The other action becomes unassigned.
shortcuts.reserved: Tab is reserved for focus navigation
shortcuts.invalid: This key combination cannot be assigned

wheel.title: Wheel actions
wheel.desc: Choose what each modifier plus wheel direction does. In webtoon mode vertical scroll wins.

mouse.title: Mouse actions
mouse.desc: Choose click and drag behavior. If right-click no longer opens the menu, use the header settings button instead.
mouse.rightClickWarning: Turning off the right-click menu removes menu access over the image

nav.title: Navigation
nav.desc: How to move at the first/last image

skipBroken.title: Skip unreadable files
skipBroken.desc: Automatically move to the next image when one cannot be read. Failed images are marked on thumbnails.

update.title: Updates
update.desc: Checks for updates only when you press the button.

licenses.title: Open source licenses
licenses.desc: View notices and license texts for the open source components AraView uses.
licenses.tablePointer: For these {{count}} packages, select one in the list on the left to read its full license text.
licenses.templatedNote: This package ships no license file, so a standard template is shown. Check the package repository for the copyright holder.
licenses.noLicenseFile: This package does not ship a license file.

imageRendering.title: Image rendering
imageRendering.desc: Choose smooth scaling or crisp pixel preservation when enlarging the main image.

webtoon.title: Webtoon details
webtoon.desc: Set image spacing, page boundaries, Fit width, and the reading position display.

reading.title: Reading
reading.desc: Resume comics (CBZ and other archives) from the last page you viewed. Cover alone shows the first page by itself in dual view. Comics with a cover set or unset from the viewer right-click menu follow that choice.
reading.comicAutoDual: Open comic archives in dual view automatically (follows ComicInfo reading direction)
reading.coverAlone: Show cover alone in dual view
reading.showComicInfo: Show comic metadata (ComicInfo.xml) in the info panel

dock.title: Image list dock
dock.desc: Thumbnail list position and display on the viewer edge

present.title: UI visibility
present.desc: Hiding options that apply only while viewing an image
present.autohide: Auto-hide UI (hides top bar, image list, and status bar after 3s idle)
present.hideMenuBar: Hide top bar (hover the very top edge to show it)

cache.title: Image preloading
cache.desc: Image preload range and cache item limit

cacheStorage.title: Cache retention
cacheStorage.desc: Choose whether thumbnails and converted images survive app exit.
cacheStorage.persistentDesc: Reuse cache after reopening the app. This is the default.
cacheStorage.temporaryDesc: Keep cache only during this run and delete it on exit.
cacheStorage.pendingDesc: The current cache stays unchanged until the storage mode changes on the next run.

cacheManagement.title: Cache management
cacheManagement.desc: Review and delete image-derived cache files for the active storage mode.
cacheManagement.errorDescription: Cache usage could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
cacheManagement.emptyDesc: Opening an image creates thumbnails and converted cache files.
cacheManagement.persistentUnavailable: Persistent cache is unavailable, so a session cache is being used.

resolution.title: Display resolution
resolution.desc: Downscale large images to the long-edge limit for display. Original files are not changed.

startup.title: Startup
startup.desc: Auto-open the last viewed image on launch

recent.title: Recent files
recent.desc: Save opened images to the home screen. Turning off clears history and stops recording.

ext.title: File associations
ext.desc: Changing an association opens the default app picker for that extension. Windows does not allow apps to set defaults directly.
ext.blockedTitle: Confirm the default app in Windows
ext.blockedDesc: Windows 10/11 only allows default app changes in the system picker. Select {{appName}} in the opened window.

thumb.title: Explorer thumbnails (PSD)
thumb.desc: Show PSD previews in Windows File Explorer. Registration is per user, so no admin rights are needed.
thumb.label: PSD Explorer thumbnails
thumb.dllMissing: Thumbnail DLL not found. Bundled with the installer. For development, build it with cargo build -p araview-thumb.
thumb.note: After applying, restart Explorer or clear the thumbnail cache to see the change.

home.emptyDesc: Drag files here or choose them with the Open File button.

webtoon.archiveHint: "{{name}}" is a comic archive. Open it as a comic to read it.

archivePreview.hint: "{{name}}" is a comic archive. Showing the first page only.

exif.title: EXIF Information
exif.empty: No EXIF data available for this image.

histogram.title: Histogram
histogram.unavailable: Histogram is not available for this format.
histogram.vectorUnavailable: Histograms are not shown for SVG vector images.

rename.title: Rename
rename.desc: Enter the full file name including extension, within the same folder.
rename.label: File name

update.availableDesc: Review the changes and choose whether to download.
update.downloadingDesc: Downloading version {{version}}. Keep the app open until it finishes.
update.downloadFail: Download failed. Try again or check later.
update.installingDesc: Download complete. The app will close briefly to install the update, then restart with the new version automatically.
update.installFail: Could not start the installation. Try again or check later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.desc: The address changed or does not exist. Go back home.

menu.toggleCover: Set or Unset Current Page as Cover

palette.title: Command Palette
palette.desc: Search for a command. Move with arrow keys and press Enter to run it.

notFound.title: File not found
notFound.hint: The file may have been moved, deleted, or the archive entry is missing. Try another file.

permission.title: Cannot access the file
permission.hint: You may lack permission or another program is using it. Check permissions and try again.

unsupported.title: Unsupported format
unsupported.hint: Check if it is a supported format (png/jpg/webp/svg/avif/heic/psd/cbz, etc.) or try another viewer.

corrupt.title: Problem reading the file
corrupt.hint: The file may be corrupted. You can go back to the last image or home.

unknown.title: Failed to load the image
unknown.hint: Try again or go home and open another file.

alwaysOnTop.fail: Failed to toggle always on top

external.fail: Failed to open with external app

assoc.openFail: Failed to open default app picker

update.latest: You are on the latest version

cache.storagePending: Cache retention saved. It applies on the next run.
cache.protectedOnly: Files currently in use were kept and could not be cleared.
cache.partial: Some in-use files were kept, so only part of the cache was cleared.

cover.fail: Could not save the cover setting

resetSettings.title: Reset settings
resetSettings.message: Reset all settings to their defaults? Your language setting will be kept.

disable.title: Turn off persistent cache
disable.message: Switching to a session cache deletes the existing persistent cache on the next run. Continue?

clearAll.title: Clear all cache
clearAll.message: Keep files currently in use and delete the remaining image cache?
